stage: AI-player architecture development; native player and playthrough qualification pending

decisions.D1: Server installation required; client mod optional. Ordinary-client compatibility remains a qualification target.
decisions.D2: Fabric on Minecraft Java 1.21.1; selected as initial bounded target
decisions.D3: Optional Claude/OpenAI APIs with operator-supplied keys; disabled by default. Provider transport/runtime integration not implemented. No Jev or mandatory hosted orchestration.
decisions.D4: Autonomous block edits are off by default; a missing edits.properties means off. An operator may record the roaming-edit policy with /aiplayer edits on: survival breaking and placing where the player itself may edit, never containers or block entities other than its own empty furnace, never spawn-protected blocks, never a lava-releasing break.
decisions.D5: Unattended progression requires qualified player mechanics, activity admission and recovery.
decisions.D6: A game mode may hand out an item only by an announced rule identical for human and AI participants (Manhunt tracking compass). No other exception to earned progress in survival modes. Not implemented.
decisions.D7: AI players attack humans only inside a match the human joined; otherwise player attacks stay refused. Not implemented.
decisions.D8: Schematics are bundled when their licenses allow or supplied by users as files or single links, with license and attribution kept; no bulk scraping. Not implemented.

polymerCore: 0.9.19+1.21.1 (bundled with its networking and registry dependencies)
clientCompatibilityQualification: Native entity contracts tested separately; actual client join matrix remains pending
localValidationJdk: OpenJDK 21 (Linux x64, 2026-10-20); earlier runs OpenJDK 21.0.2 (Windows x64)

architecture.productionGoal: Three artificial players earning a cooperative survival playthrough through the Ender Dragon
architecture.defaultBossPolicy: Unqualified encounters blocked; qualified team Dragon progression is a production objective
architecture.dependencyPolicy: Prefer free/open-source components; optional operator-funded model API usage
architecture.currentBodyBackend: NativePlayerBody through explicit development commands; CompanionEntity legacy compatibility

fixtureValidated: timed survival mining/tool wear and cancellation

automatedValidation.nativeGameTestsScope: 2026-10-20, Linux x64 OpenJDK 21: two consecutive runs passed 188/188, including the death/respawn fixture and three Nether-portal goal fixtures (obsidian from lava; frame and ignition; fighting a mob that is after the player). Full build passed with 336 JUnit results. Native fixtures and development live runs only; no live gate passed.

supportExclusions: Other Minecraft versions, integrations, unqualified modpacks/protection systems and region-threaded servers
Qualified native server-player mechanics, player lifecycle and ordinary-client join matrix
Automatic survival/recipe progression, admitted mining/drop collection and general equipment transfers
Durable teams/assignments, legacy-body conversion and full native lifecycle qualification
Unattended operation, native schedule enforcement and zero-human recovery qualification
Production combat, Nether/End travel and earned cooperative Dragon playthrough
Provider transport and runtime LLM integration
Qualified construction, rich social refinements, naming and pet lifecycle
